name: human_intents v2 migration NULL-guid tolerance (Loop 0)
goal: Make the workspace-manager v2 migration NULL-tolerant so a legacy NULL-guid human_intents row no longer crashes every workspace-manager call.

tasks.name: Make the v2 migration NULL-tolerant (TDD)
tasks.description: Add WHERE workspace_guid IS NOT NULL to the v2 migration INSERT..SELECT (db.ts:182) so a legacy NULL-guid human_intents row is dropped instead of crashing the migration on the new NOT NULL. Guard with a regression test using a legacy NULLABLE human_intents fixture (the existing V1_DDL at db.test.ts:457-462 is NOT NULL and cannot reproduce the crash). Tests run against src via vitest (no build needed for TDD); build+deploy is post-commit. Filter workspace_guid only; do not reintroduce the FK or touch other logic.

steps.description: RED.
